x.description: array_like Array of points. The dtype is converted to float64 or complex128 depending on whether any of the elements are complex. If `x` is scalar it is converted to a 1-D array.
constraints: converts x's dtype to float64 or complex128
if x is scalar, converts it to a 1-D array

deg.description: int Degree of the resulting matrix.

output.description: ------- ndarray. The Vandermonde matrix. The shape of the returned matrix is ``x.shape + (deg + 1,)``, where the last index is the power of `x`. The dtype will be the same as the converted `x`.
